utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the twelfth. Can you all hear me?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah. Thought I was on mute then. Usually am when I've got something useful to say.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: While we're waiting for everyone to settle, the heating in the portakabin — honestly, my tea's warmer than the radiator.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: The heating in the portakabin's purely decorative, that is. I've still got my coat on. Just moaning, not putting a job in.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Very smart coat, though. Really lifts the whole stores operation.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry, I'm here. Traffic on the ring road was dreadful. Sat looking at the same brake lights for absolutely ages.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, you haven't missed anything technical. Just the coat review.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, enough of that. Finished bits first, then what we're actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah so, finished the repair on the fire panel last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Fi. Closed, then, not another one for today's list.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I tested the GT1 compressor yesterday and it's all fine now. That testing's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, good. That's the compressor test put to bed.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Only other thing from me on the running side: saw the pressure on the line 3 barrel dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Mm, a transient dip, then. You're reporting what happened, not asking for another adjustment?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, just an observation here. No new action coming out of that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the dryer on Tuesday. That's already complete, in case it's still showing in anyone's notes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, dryer inspection done. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Um, my blocker hasn't changed. Can't get to the number two bearing until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, there isn't a production window confirmed. Can't pretend there's access when there isn't.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. So that's blocked, not me committing to get on it today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Keep that separate from the other bearing item, please, or we'll tie ourselves in knots.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On that other one, I'll grease and check the bearings on the GT2 bearing tomorrow. It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fi. That's the GT2 bearing with you, then, fairly important and tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, tomorrow. I'll do that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, two different bearing conversations. Teams captions will still make a complete meal of it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you send the shift handover report round tomorrow morning? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Doesn't need everyone dropping what they're doing, just don't lose it in the shuffle.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, understood. That's with me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Han, can you book a contractor to look at the Gas Turbine 1? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll book a contractor to look at the Gas Turbine 1. Fairly important, got it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you — that's the booking you're taking, not automatically going out with them?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: The booking, yeah. I'm accepting that bit, not volunteering for a visit as well.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And the Gas Turbine 1 contractor item doesn't mean we're reopening that finished compressor test, does it?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No. The GT1 compressor test I mentioned is done. Separate item.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. We also need someone to do a site visit at Northfield with the contractor after lunch. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I can't take the visit, sorry. Don't count me in for that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nor me. I can't offer to be off site after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'm not able to take it either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, the Northfield visit after lunch is still needed, but nobody's taken it. Unowned, not agreed against someone's name.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And just to be absolutely clear, my contractor booking isn't an acceptance of that visit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, understood. Keeping the two separate.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the 11kV board today at 2pm. Drop everything for that one — that's the priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. The lock-out tag-out sign-off on the 11kV board is yours, today at 2pm. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Two o'clock today, yep. Heard you clearly that time; your audio went a bit watery earlier.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, today at 2pm. And what I'm taking is the sign-off, just so the wording's right.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, that's the one at the top, rather than everything on the list being called urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Otherwise urgent just means absolutely nothing.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: There's also the purchase order for the AC1 needing a chase by the 28th. Whenever you get a chance sort of priority. I'm flagging the gap, not taking it on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to own chasing the purchase order for the AC1?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not me, I'm afraid. I know it's a stores-shaped thing, but I can't commit to it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I can't take that as well, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, nobody on the AC1 purchase order chase, then. Still by the 28th, whenever you get a chance, but no owner agreed.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Good to say that out loud. Silence on Teams can look an awful lot like agreement.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. Me mentioning it wasn't a quiet promise to do it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quick check before we finish. Han: shift handover report round tomorrow morning, not an emergency but don't let it slip; and book a contractor to look at the Gas Turbine 1, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, both accepted. Report tomorrow morning, and the contractor booking. No visit attached to my name.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I'll grease and check the bearings on the GT2 bearing tomorrow. Fairly important. That's my one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Mine's the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the 11kV board, today at 2pm. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And still unowned: do a site visit at Northfield with the contractor after lunch — not an emergency but don't let it slip — and chase the purchase order for the AC1 by the 28th, whenever you get a chance. Neither has been picked up.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep. Clear enough. And the completed stuff stays completed, thankfully.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone.
